name: Drupal.org Links
description: Field formatters that output links to Drupal.org.
project_description:
A list of field formatters for turning various fields into links to drupal.org.

 Current formatters 
 
 Comment link - converts a number to a link in the format https://www.drupal.org/comment/[VALUE] . 
 Node link - converts a number to a link in the format https://www.drupal.org/node/[VALUE] . 
 User link - converts a number to a link in the format https://www.drupal.org/user/[VALUE] . 
 
 All formatters support integer, decimal and string values, they take the integer value of the number.
